Class OrthographyBuilder

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.extensions.ExtendableObject
ca.phon.orthography.OrthographyBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
IExtendable
public final class OrthographyBuilder extends ExtendableObject
Class for building Orthography from various sources. This class is not thread-safe.
